editions.underlyingWork: Recording the text and making the recording available are the author's economic rights (Danish Copyright Act section 2). They expired with the text term on 2016-12-31 (Wells died 1946). The narrator speaks only the reviewed, hash-pinned converted text.
editions.performers: No human performance is recorded. Speech is synthesised with the provider's stock voices under the provider agreement; no custom or cloned voice is used.
editions.sourceTerms: The Project Gutenberg licence, header and trademark text are removed before conversion, so the spoken text contains no Gutenberg material. Gutenberg's licence states that stripped text is a public-domain ebook; the trademark is not used in audio.

providerTerms.checkMethod: Search-index excerpt of the published terms; a direct fetch was refused (HTTP 403). These are the same terms that already govern Tinct's production Grok narration.

editions.disclosure: The Add card states that narration is computer-generated and prepared only on Listen.

editions.notes: Conservative engineering record, not a lawyer's clearance. It depends on, and is invalidated by any change to, the Danish text review for the same edition hash.
